python3 -c "
import statistics

# USDA outlays 1990-1998 from bulletins (in millions of dollars)
years = list(range(0, 9))   # 1990=0, 1991=1, ..., 1998=8
outlays = [46011, 54119, 56436, 63143, 60812, 56667, 54338, 52558, 53949]

n = len(years)
print('Data points:', list(zip([y+1990 for y in years], outlays)))
print('n =', n)

xbar = statistics.mean(years)
ybar = statistics.mean(outlays)
print('xbar =', xbar)
print('ybar =', ybar)

num = sum((x - xbar) * (y - ybar) for x, y in zip(years, outlays))
den = sum((x - xbar)**2 for x in years)
slope = num / den
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print('slope =', slope)
print('intercept =', intercept)

# Predict 1999: year = 9
x_pred = 9
y_pred = slope * x_pred + intercept
print('Predicted 1999 outlay (millions) =', y_pred)
print('slope rounded to hundredths =', round(slope, 2))
print('intercept rounded to whole =', round(intercept))
print('prediction rounded to whole =', round(y_pred))
"

}

# OLS regression
years_list = [y - 1990 for y in range(1990, 1999)]
